versions.content: The CanTp module shall not acc ept the receiving or the transmission of N - SDU with the same identifier in parallel, because otherwise the received frames cannot be assigned to the correct connection. When only specific connections (without MetaData) are used, this requirement is enforce d by the configuration, because each N - SDU is linked to only one connection channel.
